title: Pulmonologist visit
what: A doctor who treats the lungs and airways. They listen to your breathing and check how well your lungs work.
why: For a long-lasting cough, shortness of breath, asthma, frequent bronchitis, or changes on a chest scan.
tell_doctor: How long you have had the cough or shortness of breath, and what makes it worse
If you smoke or used to smoke
Work with dust or chemicals, or contact with animals
What inhalers and medicines you use

prepare.title: Smoking
prepare.text: If your breathing will be tested, do not smoke for at least a few hours before. Check with the clinic.

prepare.title: Scans
prepare.text: Bring chest X-rays or CT scans, if you had them.

bring: Past test results, discharge papers, and reports
A list of your medicines, or the packs themselves
steps: The doctor asks about your symptoms
Your blood oxygen is measured with a sensor on your finger
Sometimes a breathing test called spirometry is done right away
feel: In the breathing test, you blow out hard. You may feel a little dizzy
after: The doctor may check that you use your inhaler correctly
Do not change treatment on your own. Ask the doctor
red_flags: Severe shortness of breath at rest, blue lips, or coughing up blood: call emergency services

faq.a: The doctor will check that you use it correctly. It is a common reason treatment does not work.

faq.q: Do I need a chest scan beforehand?
faq.a: If you have one, bring it. The doctor will decide if a new one is needed.

reminders.text: Pulmonologist visit tomorrow. Bring your chest scans and your inhalers.
